snippet.title: Revelation of Decay Demo Expansion Trailer - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
Revelation of Decay is a pixel-art sandbox survival game set in a collapsing, zombie-infested world. It mixes scavenging, building, exploration and combat. Recruit NPC companions, capture zombies to power your base, and confront bizarre creatures as you travel through biomes. This trailer was featured in the 2025 Convergence Games Showcase.

Play the expanded demo and wishlist the game now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2975680
